text: Five students from Michigan drive to [a remote cabin in the hills of Tennessee|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], where a porch swing moves by itself and a cellar trapdoor flies open during dinner. Below they find [a book with a face on its cover and a tape of incantations|images|books, letters and writing], and when Scott plays it, something wakes in the woods. The trees attack, the only bridge is gone, and one by one the friends [turn into white-eyed monsters|threat|being taken over] that can only be stopped by dismemberment.
